verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fixed, built-in automations: daily test monitoring with email alerts, follow-up tasks created during access reviews, and recurring review schedules with reminders. Nothing documents a user-definable rule engine where a user configures event conditions that trigger chosen actions. Recurring schedules are not event-triggered rules, and preset alerts are an adjacent feature, not user-defined rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
